channel.provenance_note: The official Swiss Parliament live player exposes this Akamai HLS manifest. Parliamentary Services also publish third-party iframe instructions for the National Council stream.

accessibility.notes: The official National Council live page provides automatically generated subtitles and warns that they may contain errors.

permission.summary: Swiss Parliamentary Services explicitly allow third parties to embed the National Council and Council of States live streams and publish responsive iframe code and language parameters. This documents third-party embedding; it does not by itself grant broader rights to alter or redistribute recordings.
permission.recommendation: Embed or play the unaltered official National Council stream with clear Swiss Parliament attribution. Review separate terms before modifying, archiving, or redistributing recordings beyond the documented live-embed use.
